questions.stem: 對一般人來說，要負擔太空旅遊的高昂費用並不容易，使它成為有錢人的特權。
questions.answer: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford the high cost of space tourism, making it a privilege of the rich.
accepted_answers: It is difficult for average people to afford the enormous cost of space tourism, turning it into a privilege for the wealthy.
For ordinary people, it is hard to afford the high price of space trips, making them a privilege enjoyed only by the rich.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

questions.stem: 送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘，可能會對地球造成比我們想像中更大的傷害。
questions.answer: Sending a few wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun may do more harm to the earth than we imagine.
accepted_answers: Sending a handful of rich people to space for a few minutes of fun may cause greater damage to the earth than we expect.
Taking a small number of rich people into space for just a few minutes could harm the planet more seriously than we think.

1.explanation_zh: 「對一般人來說，要負擔…並不容易」的主詞是「負擔費用」這件事，英文用虛主詞 It is not easy for ordinary people to afford …（for sb 放在形容詞後面），不能寫 Ordinary people are not easy to …。「高昂費用」是 high cost／high price（不說 expensive cost）。「使它成為有錢人的特權」是前面這件事的結果，用句尾分詞 , making it a privilege of the rich；the rich＝有錢人（複數意義）。
evidence: 要負擔太空旅遊的高昂費用並不容易
使它成為有錢人的特權
1.strategy_zh: 中文「對某人來說，做某事很難／不容易」幾乎都要改成 It is + 形容詞 + for sb + to V。
hints: 切成四段：對一般人來說／要負擔太空旅遊的高昂費用／並不容易／使它成為有錢人的特權
標的詞彙：ordinary（一般的）、afford（負擔得起）、cost（費用）、tourism（旅遊）、privilege（特權）、rich（有錢的）
句型框架：It is not + adj. + for sb + to V …, making it + N

2.explanation_zh: 主詞「送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘」是一個動作，用動名詞片語 Sending a few wealthy people into space …。「比我們想像中更大的傷害」用比較級 more harm … than we imagine：harm 不可數，「造成傷害」用 do／cause harm to。「幾分鐘」是 a few minutes（few 是「幾乎沒有」）；space 不加 the。
evidence: 送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘
比我們想像中更大的傷害
2.strategy_zh: 中文「比我們想像中更…」直接寫 more … than we imagine／think，比較級放在名詞前，than 子句放句尾。
hints: 切成四段：送少數富人上太空／玩幾分鐘／可能會對地球造成／比我們想像中更大的傷害
標的詞彙：wealthy（富有的）、space（太空）、minute（分鐘）、harm（傷害）、earth（地球）、imagine（想像）
句型框架：V-ing … + may + do more harm to + N + than + S + V

references: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford the high cost of space tourism, making it a privilege of the rich.
It is difficult for average people to afford the enormous cost of space tourism, turning it into a privilege for the wealthy.
For ordinary people, it is hard to afford the high price of space trips, making them a privilege enjoyed only by the rich.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使它成為…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, making + O + N ／ turning + O + into + N

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋for sb＋不定詞
patterns.frame: It is (not) + adj. + for sb + to V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 要負擔太空旅遊的高昂費用並不容易

accepted: for ordinary people
for average people
for most people
for common people

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「一般人」是 ordinary／average people；general 是「整體的、概括的」，不用來修飾人。
泛指一般人用複數 people；person 是可數單數，不能沒有冠詞。

parts.zh: 要負擔太空旅遊的高昂費用
accepted: to afford the high cost of space tourism
to afford the enormous cost of space tourism
to afford the high price of space trips
to afford the high cost of space travel
to pay for expensive space trips

common_errors.wrong: to afford the expensive cost of space tourism
common_errors.right: to afford the high cost of space tourism
common_errors.explanation_zh: cost／price 搭配 high，不說 expensive cost（expensive 是指東西貴）。

common_errors.wrong: to burden the high cost of space tourism
common_errors.right: to afford the high cost of space tourism
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「負擔得起（費用）」用 afford；burden 是「使負重擔」。

accepted: It is not easy
It is difficult
it is hard
It is not simple

common_errors.wrong: Ordinary people are not easy to afford
common_errors.right: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford
common_errors.explanation_zh: easy／hard 不能說「人是容易的」；用虛主詞 It is not easy for sb to V。

common_errors.wrong: It is not easy of ordinary people to afford
common_errors.right: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford
common_errors.explanation_zh: 描述事情難易用 for sb；of sb 用在描述人的特質（kind、careless）。

parts.zh: 使它成為有錢人的特權
accepted: making it a privilege of the rich
turning it into a privilege for the wealthy
making them a privilege enjoyed only by the rich
which makes it a privilege of the rich
making it a privilege for rich people

common_errors.wrong: makes it become a privilege of the rich
common_errors.right: making it a privilege of the rich
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後直接接 makes 會變成兩個動詞沒有連接詞；表結果用 making it + 名詞，不必加 become。

common_errors.wrong: making it a privilege of rich
common_errors.right: making it a privilege of the rich
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「有錢人」是 the rich（the＋形容詞＝一群人），不能只寫 rich。

common_errors.wrong: making it a special right of the rich
common_errors.right: making it a privilege of the rich
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「特權」是 privilege；special right 是逐字直譯。

traps.literal_error: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford the expensive cost of space tourism …
traps.explanation_zh: 「高昂的費用」是 high cost／high price；expensive 用來形容東西貴，不和 cost、price 連用。

traps.zh: 要負擔太空旅遊的高昂費用並不容易
traps.literal_error: Ordinary people are not easy to afford the high cost of space tourism …
traps.explanation_zh: 「不容易」的是「負擔費用」這件事，不是人；英文用虛主詞 It is not easy for ordinary people to afford …。

bonus.text: So high is the cost of space tourism that few ordinary people can afford it, which turns space travel into a privilege of the rich.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 形容詞 + be + 主詞 + that … 的倒裝強調費用之高；屬於加分寫法，基本句型仍是 It is not easy for sb to V。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文「對一般人來說，要負擔…並不容易」的主詞是「負擔費用」這個動作；英文把動作移到句尾，用虛主詞 It is not easy for ordinary people to afford …；「使它成為…」用句尾分詞 making it … 表結果，不要另起「這使得」的句子。

references: Sending a few wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun may do more harm to the earth than we imagine.
Sending a handful of rich people to space for a few minutes of fun may cause greater damage to the earth than we expect.
Taking a small number of rich people into space for just a few minutes could harm the planet more seriously than we think.

patterns.zh_trigger: 送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘

patterns.frame: S + V + more + N + to … + than + S + V

accepted: Sending a few wealthy people into space
Sending a handful of rich people to space
Taking a small number of rich people into space
Sending a few rich people into space
Flying a few wealthy people into space

common_errors.wrong: Send a few rich people into space may
common_errors.right: Sending a few rich people into space may
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞（或 To V），原形動詞不能當主詞。

common_errors.wrong: Sending a few rich people into the space
common_errors.right: Sending a few rich people into space

accepted: for a few minutes of fun
for just a few minutes
for a few minutes
to have fun for a few minutes

common_errors.explanation_zh: few 是「幾乎沒有」；「幾分鐘」要用 a few minutes。

common_errors.wrong: to play for a few minutes
common_errors.right: for a few minutes of fun
common_errors.explanation_zh: 這裡的「玩」是遊玩、體驗，用 for fun／for a few minutes of fun，不要譯成 play（像小孩玩耍）。

accepted: may do more harm to the earth
may cause greater damage to the earth
could harm the planet more seriously
may do more damage to the planet
might cause more harm to the earth

common_errors.wrong: may make more harm to the earth
common_errors.right: may do more harm to the earth
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「造成傷害」是 do harm to／cause harm to，不用 make。

common_errors.wrong: may do more harms to the earth
common_errors.right: may do more harm to the earth
common_errors.explanation_zh: harm 當「傷害」是不可數名詞，不加 s。

parts.zh: 比我們想像中更大的傷害
accepted: than we imagine
than we expect
than we think
than we might imagine
than we can imagine

common_errors.explanation_zh: 比較的對象要對等：傷害的程度和「我們想像的程度」比，用 than we imagine（子句），不寫 than our imagination。
than 後面的子句省略受詞，不要再加 it。

traps.zh: 送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘
traps.literal_error: Send a few rich people into space for a few minutes may do more harm …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文以整個動作當主詞；英文要用動名詞 Sending …（或 To send …），原形動詞不能當主詞。

traps.literal_error: … may make more harm to the earth than we imagine.
traps.explanation_zh: 「造成傷害」是 do／cause harm to；harm 不可數，不加 s，也不和 make 連用。

bonus.text: Little do we realize how much harm sending a few wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun may do to the earth.
bonus.explanation_zh: Little do we realize … 的否定倒裝強調「我們根本沒想到」；屬於加分寫法，不設為唯一正解。

1.translation: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford the high cost of space tourism, which makes it a privilege of the rich.
1.explanation_zh: 「對一般人來說，要…並不容易」用虛主詞句型 It is not easy for sb to V；「負擔…費用」用 afford；「使它成為…特權」用 which makes it 承接前句，it 指 space tourism；「有錢人」用 the rich（也可用 the wealthy）。

2.translation: Sending a handful of wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun may do more harm to the Earth than we imagine.
2.explanation_zh: 「送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘」用動名詞片語當主詞；「對地球造成…傷害」用 do harm to；「比我們想像中更大的」用比較級 more harm ... than we imagine（也可寫 cause greater damage to the Earth than we think）。

issues_zh: 「使它成為有錢人的特權」我自然寫成 , which makes it a privilege of the rich（非限定關係子句），沒有用分詞構句，所以 used_patterns 不含 PART：中文「使它成為」沒有唯一引出 PART。
第 4 部分 targets 標 PART，accepted 卻收 which makes it a privilege of the rich（關係子句，不是分詞構句），句型標註和可接受寫法不一致。建議把 PART 放寬成「句尾補述結果（分詞構句或 which 子句皆可）」，或刪掉 which makes it 那一條並在中文加強提示。
（小問題）R2 的 a privilege enjoyed only by the rich 多了「只有」，屬可接受的引申。
（小問題）R2 與第 2 部分 accepted 的 for (just) a few minutes 沒譯出「玩」，語意略有流失（just 稍可補償），可接受。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PART']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）
第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：「使它成為有錢人的特權」我自然寫成 , which makes it a privilege of the rich（非限定關係子句），沒有用分詞構句，所以 used_patterns 不含 PART：中文「使它成為」沒有唯一引出 PART

1.translation: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford the high cost of space tourism, making it a privilege of the wealthy.
1.explanation_zh: 「要……並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy for ... to ...；負擔費用用 afford the high cost；「使它成為……」用分詞片語 making it a privilege。

2.translation: Sending a few wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun may do more harm to the Earth than we imagine.
2.explanation_zh: 主詞用動名詞片語 Sending ... into space；「比我們想像中更大的傷害」用比較級 more harm ... than we imagine；可能用 may。
